The lighthouse stands at the far end of a narrow island about 2 miles off the coast for more than 100 years it has worn ships away from the rocks that I just under the surface at high tide The first keeper arrived in the spring with his wife two goats and a crate of books he wrote in his logbook every single evening even on nights when nothing happened at all In the winter of the third year a storm came in from the north and lasted for nine days the waves climbed higher than the keeper had ever seen and spray rattled against the glass at the top of the tower On the fourth night the main lamp went dark he climbed the spiral stairs with a lantern in one hand and a box of spare wicks in the other counting every step so he would not lose his footing He relate the lamp just before midnight out in the dark a fishing boat that had been drifting toward the rocks turned sharply and made its way safely into the harbor Years later the captain of that boat wrote a letter to the keeper he said that he had given up hope that night and let the light appearing out of nowhere had felt like a small miracle Today the lamp runs on its own powered by solar panels and no one lives on the island anymore visitors can take a fairy out in the summer and climb the same spiral stairs Thank you for listening to this short test
